description_expanded: Designed for laid-back luxury, Endless Sunset (formerly Southern Wind) is a beautifully updated four-bedroom vacation home that comfortably accommodates up to eight beach-loving guests. Unlike many vacation rentals, this home features only adult-size beds—offering an elevated level of comfort and privacy for couples, friends, and multi-generational families. Nestled in a tranquil enclave south of Scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach , this coastal retreat blends modern elegance with effortless relaxation. The open-concept living space is bathed in natural light, with stylish furnishings and high-end finishes that make it feel like a true home away from home. A wraparound dove-gray couch and regal armchair provide a cozy gathering spot in the living area, facing a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV. The adjacent dining space features a mix of cottage-style and tropical-woven chairs surrounding a sleek table, while the spacious kitchen is a dream for any home chef. Custom light teal cabinetry, gleaming quartz countertops, a glass-brick backsplash, and brushed stainless steel appliances—including a French cabinet-style refrigerator—create a stunning yet functional space. Multiple verandas provide shaded outdoor seating, perfect for enjoying morning coffee or sunset cocktails. Luxury Accommodations Across Three Levels The first floor features a private guest suite with a queen-size bed framed by a tufted beige headboard, a flatscreen TV for evening entertainment, and a full bath with a wide glass-walled walk-in shower. On the second level, a bright and airy guest bedroom offers a new king-size bed and an ensuite bath with double vanity sinks and a tub-shower combination. A full hall bath also serves as a convenient powder room off the main living area. The top floor hosts the primary suite and another guest bedroom, both with vaulted ceilings, new king-size beds, private access to upper-level verandas, and luxurious ensuite baths featuring double vanity sinks and walk-in showers. Private Pool & Outdoor Entertainment The private backyard oasis invites guests to enjoy a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear swimming pool, which becomes even more enchanting when illuminated at night. A screened porch and two covered verandas provide the perfect setting for outdoor relaxation, whether you’re sipping a drink, enjoying a good book, or indulging in alfresco dining. A gas grill is available for poolside cookouts, making it easy to prepare fresh local seafood or family favorites while taking in the serene surroundings. Scenic Beauty & Outdoor Adventures This home’s location is just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, where breathtaking sunrises and sunsets await. However, its natural surroundings offer more than just beach access. Endless Sunset sits near the edge of Draper Lake , a rare Coastal Dune Lake found in only a few places in the world. These rare ecosystems feature a creek-like tributary that shifts directions with the tides, blending freshwater with the salty Gulf. The result is a thriving habitat for fish, waterfowl, and an array of wildlife. Whether you prefer exploring by paddleboard, fishing in the calm waters, or simply enjoying the view, this natural wonder adds another dimension to your coastal getaway. Close to Gulf Place & 30A’s Best Attractions Just a two-minute drive away, Gulf Place serves as the lively coastal village center of Santa Rosa Beach. Named one of Travel & Leisure’s top five favorite beach towns, this vibrant destination is home to excellent restaurants, friendly bars, an ice cream parlor, a coffee shop, boutique shops, and art galleries. At the heart of Gulf Place is a palm-lined outdoor amphitheater that hosts live music, art shows, and seasonal festivals, making it the perfect place to soak in the 30A lifestyle. Whether you’re lounging by the private pool, exploring the scenic beauty of Draper Lake, or indulging in the laid-back charm of Gulf Place, Endless Sunset offers a perfect blend of relaxation, adventure, and coastal elegance. Book your stay today and experience the magic of 30A! First Floor: Queen Bedroom and Full Bathroom with Walk-in Shower. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Full Bathroom, and Laundry. Third Floor: King Primary Suite with Full Bathroom with a Walk-in Shower, and King Primary with Full Bathroom with a Walk-in Shower. *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
